message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of key players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey—both current stars and notable alumni:

| Current (2025‑26) | Notable Former Players |
|-------------------|------------------------|
| **Paul George** – All‑Star forward, 2019‑20 MVP of the NBA Finals (with the Lakers) |
| **Kawhi Leonard** – Two‑time NBA champion, 2019‑20 Defensive Player of the Year |
| **Julius Randle** – 2020‑21 NBA Most Improved Player |
| **Reggie Jackson** – 2021‑22 NBA Sixth Man of the Year |
| **Bam Adebayo** – 2022‑23 NBA Defensive Player of the Year |
| **Jalen Green** – Rising star, 2023‑24 NBA Rookie of the Year |
| **Darius Miles** – 2024‑25 NBA Sixth Man of the Year |
| **Mason Plumlee** – 2025‑26 NBA Sixth Man of the Year |

### Hall‑of‑Fame & Legendary Alumni
- **Chris Paul** – 2008‑09 NBA MVP, 2019‑20 NBA Finals MVP (with the Lakers)
- **Blake Griffin** – 2010‑11 NBA Rookie of the Year, 2011‑12 NBA MVP (with the Lakers)
- **DeAndre Jordan** – 2014‑15 NBA Sixth Man of the Year (with the Lakers)
- **Gary Payton** – 1997‑98 NBA Defensive Player of the Year (with the Lakers)
- **Kobe Bryant** – 1996‑97 NBA Rookie of the Year (with the Lakers)

> *Note:* The Clippers’ roster evolves each season, so the “current” lineup above reflects the 2025‑26 roster as of the latest trade deadline.
